Kalinga National Bank
Bank Guarantee Department
BG No: BG/40
Date: 04 Sep 2019
To,
The Employer / Commissioner
Subject: Performance Bond — Buildings Works (Tender RFP-132004074)
Dear Sir / Madam,
At the request of M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (the Contractor), we, Kalinga National Bank, hereby irrevocably and
unconditionally undertake to pay you, on first written demand and without demur, any sum not exceeding Rs. 0 (Rupees 0 Only) toward
the Contractor's obligations under the captioned tender.
This guarantee remains in force up to and including 09 Aug 2022, after which it stands automatically discharged unless a claim in
writing is received by us on or before that date. Our liability is restricted to the amount stated above. Payment instructions: IFSC
KNBX0004417.
Authorised Signatory
Kalinga National Bank
